entries.title: Foundation
entries.definitive_edition: Foundation on Windows PC, version 1.0 or later

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Foundation is a Windows PC release, and the 1.0 version is the complete route after Early Access. PC is also the only sourced platform and the best capture/settings route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam or GOG; use version 1.0 or later for the full-release feature set.

entries.remaster_caveats: Version 1.0 is the full release after Early Access, not a remaster or separate game entry.
